target_pattern: Use para plus infinitive with same subject and para que plus subjunctive with subject change, including imperfect subjunctive after past main clauses for intended outcomes.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one to plus verb structure for every purpose expression.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish purpose clauses split by subject continuity and tense alignment across clauses.
target_pattern_formula: subject change present or future meaning: para que plus present subjunctive
subject change after past main verb with would meaning: para que plus imperfect subjunctive
commands can take para que plus subjunctive purpose clauses
natural_examples: Trabajo todos los dias para ahorrar dinero.
Hago videos para que mejores tu espanol.
Cierra la puerta para que el gato no se escape.
Pinte la casa para que se vendiera mas rapido.
Le explique todo para que supiera la verdad.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Trabajo duro para ahorrar dinero. -> change to subject-change version with mi familia.
Base: Estudio todas las noches para aprobar. -> change to para que with mis padres.
Base: Cierra la puerta para que el gato no se escape. -> change noun to los perros.
Base: Hago ejercicio para sentirme mejor. -> change to subject-change with mi medico.
Base: Te llamo para que sepas el plan. -> change recipient to plural ustedes.
Base: Nos fuimos temprano para que no empezaran sin nosotros. -> change to present-time version.
Base: Pinte la casa para que se vendiera mas rapido. -> change object to el coche.
Base: Le conte todo para que supiera la verdad. -> change person to plural ellos.
Base: Cambiamos el horario para que todos llegaran a tiempo. -> change noun to singular Juan.
Base: Escribio instrucciones para que nadie se confundiera. -> change to present-time version.
Base: Bajaron los precios para que los clientes compraran mas. -> change tense to present main clause.
Base: Guarde ese correo para mostrarlo despues. -> change infinitive to revisarlo.
Base: Revisamos todo para evitar errores. -> change purpose noun to problemas.
Base: Encendi las luces para que pudieras ver mejor. -> change to present command with tu.
Base: Traje una chaqueta para que no tuvieras frio. -> change to first person plural main clause.

prompts: I study to learn. (Estudio para aprender. vs Estudio para que aprenda.)
I study so that my son learns. (Estudio para que mi hijo aprenda. vs Estudio para aprender mi hijo.)
We left early so they would not start. (Nos fuimos temprano para que no empezaran. vs Nos fuimos temprano para no empezar.)
She called me so that I know. (Me llamo para que sepa. vs Me llamo para saber.)
I painted it so that it would sell faster. (Lo pinte para que se vendiera mas rapido. vs Lo pinte para venderse mas rapido.)
I am saving for travel. (Ahorro para viajar. vs Ahorro para que viaje.)
Turn on the light so that we can read. (Enciende la luz para que podamos leer. vs Enciende la luz para leer podamos.)
I explained it so they would understand. (Lo explique para que entendieran. vs Lo explique para entender.)
We organized everything so nobody gets confused. (Organizamos todo para que nadie se confunda. vs Organizamos todo para no confundir.)
I brought coffee to wake up. (Traje cafe para despertarme. vs Traje cafe para que me despierte.)

common_errors.correct_spanish: Use para que plus subjunctive when subjects differ.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Use para plus infinitive when subject stays the same.

common_errors.why_it_happens: No tense backshifting in purpose clause.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use imperfect subjunctive after past main clause.

common_errors.mistake: Dropping que in subject-change purpose clause

common_errors.correct_spanish: Match person and number in subordinate clause.

common_errors.mistake: Literal English order in purpose clauses
Missing reflexive pronouns in infinitive purpose clauses
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep pronoun in infinitive when required.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Future meaning interpreted as future morphology.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use subjunctive, not future, after para que.
